acceptance: Workflow tests: schedule + dispatch triggers; the skip path set is a superset of the reuse guarded inputs (test imports both); same shard matrix as release-v2 (asserted against the live release-v2.yml); evidence names include the source sha
Skip-baseline test: a change, then a deferred run, then the next scheduled run executes (deferred and skipped runs never become the baseline)
Negative test: a run where zero cells executed fails with a named reason

Concurrency: trunk-uat defers ('deferred: release-v2 run <id> in progress') while a release-v2 run is in progress, and release-v2's fallback cancels an in-progress trunk-uat run; both recorded in summaries; tests

G12 calibration before merge: at least one hosted run via a temporary push trigger on the batch integration branch completes; wall time, runner-hours and per-shard state are recorded here; the temporary trigger is removed before the final PR
After merge: a scheduled or dispatched run on develop succeeds, and a following scheduled run with no relevant change skips in under 5 minutes with 'skipped: unchanged since <sha>'
Per-cell history from the calibration run is readable by the rv2r-04 and rv2r-11 scripts

After the calibration run, every open tracker item matching `release-uat-*`, `uat-*-20261030` or `*-uat-failures-20261030` is finished with that run's cell evidence or updated with its current cell history; coverage-restoring items (cedardb-/databend-release-uat-coverage, influxdb-general-loader-uat) stay open and need a G12 calibration before re-entering the gate
No change to stage configs, timeouts, memory limits, validators or floors

2026-11-08: dispatched first post-merge develop trunk UAT acceptance run 42536258036 at 23:43Z. Existing schedule remains 02:00 UTC. Six-hour job limits and 30 runner-hour decision gate unchanged. Check hosted artifact/record and retry counters after completion; the next unchanged scheduled run is still required before finish.

Trunk UAT run 42536258036 (source 2d796acd59) completed with 702/710 passing cells (8 failures: 4 SingleStore, 2 Doris, 2 DuckDB). Scheduled 02:00 run skipped cleanly when source SHA was unchanged. Fixes: PR #4063 recognizes native SingleStore 1712: error prefix for single retry; PR #4064 fixes DuckDB struct_pack naming collision in read_primitives; Doris/SingleStore 4 GiB envelope regressions diagnosed (Parquet stream load unchunked, session parallelism). Correction to the previous note: the scheduled run did not skip. Scheduled run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/actions/runs/42591157509 ran again on admitted source 2d796acd59 and repeated the same failures. This is the designed behaviour: scripts/trunk_uat.py decide() skips a scheduled run only when the previous run's record is green, and run 42536258036 was red. The unchanged-source skip is therefore still unverified; it needs a green baseline run first. Also, PR #4063 makes SingleStore 1712 failures retry once, but those failures repeat at the same ~3.5 GiB ceiling, so a retry is not expected to turn them green.
description: Owner decision 2026-11-05: UAT becomes a continuous property of trunk. Add `.github/workflows/trunk-uat.yml` (02:00 UTC schedule plus workflow_dispatch) that runs the three release-gate stage configs as the parallel shard jobs release-v2 uses, against the trunk dist of the newest releasable develop commit (selection rule from rv2r-09). Skip rule: a scheduled run skips when nothing in the skip path set changed since the skip baseline; workflow_dispatch always runs. The skip baseline is the last run that executed shards; skipped and deferred runs never become the baseline. The skip path set is the union of GUARDED_TREES imported from scripts/release_reuse_uat_evidence.py, benchbox/, uv.lock, .github/workflows/trunk-uat.yml and .github/workflows/release-v2.yml (imported, not duplicated). Reuse the release-uat-env action, the shard matrix and make uat-gate-check; do not fork the harness. Each run uploads shard evidence and a gate summary (90-day retention) bound to the source commit and dist digest, and appends per-cell results (terminal state, elapsed, peak memory, failure signature, attempt number) to a history store readable by scripts. The run fails when zero cells executed (fail-closed detector 3). It does not start while a release-v2 run is in progress (deferred). release-v2's full-UAT fallback cancels an in-progress trunk-uat run, recorded in both summaries. Rollback: revert the workflow commit; release-v2's full-UAT fallback is unchanged.
